description:
A biomedical engineer needs to generate a 'safety margin' model of a patient's skull to assist in designing a custom cranial implant. This involves creating a standard bone model and a second 'dilated' (thickened) model. 

The CT Cranium DICOM dataset is already loaded in InVesalius 3.

Your goal is to export two 3D surface models (STLs) of the cranium:
1. Create a segmentation mask using a standard Bone threshold (e.g., 226–3071 HU), generate a 3D surface, and export it as a binary STL to '/home/ga/Documents/anatomical_skull.stl'.
2. Use the 'Morphological Operations' tool (found in the Mask or Segmentation menu) to apply a Dilation filter to the mask (1-2 iterations or 1 voxel radius is sufficient). Generate a new 3D surface from this dilated mask and export it as a binary STL to '/home/ga/Documents/dilated_skull.stl'.

Login: username 'ga', password 'password123'.
